algorithm.reason: Sequential unbounded spigot written in Mech with general GMP-backed bigint operations. Both extract(3) and extract(4) are evaluated for each tested candidate. The advance variant uses the same impossible-candidate guard as the pinned Rust #4 source; no alternative pi algorithm or digit cache.

Four source functions: coefficient, apply, apply-transpose, and step. Twenty power-method applications execute forty matrix-vector products. Coefficients are computed by emitted Mech arithmetic; no stored matrix or answer shortcut.
Full symplectic pair integration is written in Mech. The generic reactive runner supplies iteration count and output formatting; it contains no gravity kernel.

The Mech-defined callback performs double-precision escape iteration for every pixel, with a maximum of 50 iterations, and emits the complete PBM. Native SIMD and lane termination preserve that algorithm.

Nine independent regex counts, each using its prescribed pattern, and five ordered regex substitutions. The general regex library handles each operation; there is no combined-pattern benchmark matcher.

Full bottom-up construction and traversal of distinct ordinary nodes, including equally allocated leaves. Uses the general core library memory pool through memory/with-arena and memory/with-frame. This allocation strategy must be disclosed; it is not a default-GC comparison.
algorithm.allocation_policy: General core library pool; distinct 16-byte node slots; per-tree frame release.

algorithm.reason: The Mech program enumerates all factorial permutations in the required factoradic order, performs actual prefix flips, and reduces the alternating checksum and maximum. Parallel ranges cover the full permutation domain.

Strict comparison disables the general exact-integer-cutoff transform. Emitted objects retain floating division/comparison. Each random nucleotide advances the naive LCG. The only repeated-sequence cache is for the supplied fixed ALU string.

All overlapping keys at all seven lengths perform a library hash-table entry lookup/update. No query-only search or indexed-count substitute. The runtime checks each merged histogram total against its window count.
Buffered growing record input; full record reversal, alphabet translation, and 60-column output. The implementation does not use file size to preallocate stdin.
